On this page

no-commit-work ​

Category: Security & Robustness  |  Severity: warning  |  Finding Code: NO_COMMIT  |  QuickFix: No

Description ​

Avoid COMMIT WORK / ROLLBACK WORK in behavior implementations.

❌ Non-Compliant Code ​

abap
" Inside a RAP behavior implementation (CL_ABAP_BEHAVIOR_HANDLER)
METHOD update.
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF ...
  COMMIT WORK.
ENDMETHOD.

✅ Compliant Code ​

abap
" In RAP, commits are managed automatically by the framework save sequence
METHOD update.
  MODIFY ENTITIES OF ...
ENDMETHOD.

🤫 Suppression & Pseudo-Comments ​

To suppress findings for this rule, append the pseudo-comment or pragma to the statement:

abap
" Using pseudo-comment:
... "#EC COMMIT_WORK
" Or with SAP CI_ prefix:
... "#EC CI_COMMIT_WORK

" Using pragma:
... ##COMMIT_WORK.
" Or with SAP CI_ prefix:
... ##CI_COMMIT_WORK.

Configuration (skylint.yaml) ​

yaml
checks:
  no-commit-work:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning

ABAP Class Details ​

  • Native ATC Class: ZCL_SKYLINT_NO_COMMIT_WORK
  • Implementation File: zcl_skylint_no_commit_work.clas.abap
